chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: … › Business Requirement
chunks.text: TP (Transfer Price) Mapping Configuration through UI

chunks.title: Objective
chunks.heading: … › Objective
chunks.text: Enable users to configure and update Transfer Price mapping directly through the UI instead of relying on backend configuration. The system should support new TP configurations for future orders and provide an option to update previously created open orders with the latest TP details.

chunks.title: Current System Behavior
chunks.heading: … › Current System Behavior
chunks.text: Currently, TP mapping in Martex is configured through backend processes. Once the TP configuration is set and orders are created, the TP mapping cannot be modified through the UI.

chunks.title: 1. TP Mapping Update through UI
chunks.heading: … › Current System Behavior › 1. TP Mapping Update through UI
chunks.text:
Enable UI-based TP mapping configuration updates by allowing users to add a new TP mapping against the same buyer. Upon saving, the system should automatically replace and update the existing TP configuration with the newly configured TP mapping.
When TP Mapping or End Customer information is updated:
• All newly created orders should use the latest TP configuration.
• Existing TP configurations should remain unchanged for already created orders unless explicitly updated using the previous order update functionality.

• New orders created after TP updates
• Future split orders generated from existing orders
• New orders created using the "Add New Summary" option under previously created Main OCs

chunks.title: Requirement
chunks.heading: 2. Previous Orders Update › Requirement
chunks.text:
When a new TP configuration is introduced, users should have the option to update previously created open orders using the latest TP pricing and End Customer details.
These updates will be done through the Delivery Update UI:
Action: "Update Previous Orders"
Users can:
• Select End Customer
• Initiate TP update for previous orders
Update should apply only to:
• Orders not yet ASN Saved
• Orders not yet ASN Confirmed
Orders already ASN saved or confirmed should not be updated.
Validations:
• Users should be able to search for orders using either the Style Number or Main OC Number to identify and update orders associated with a specific Main OC.
• The system should provide Copy Below and Copy All functionalities for both columns, enabling users to efficiently replicate values across records.
